gov11.lookAhead.empty.title: The project has no look-ahead plan yet
gov11.lookAhead.empty.body: Draft the plan of the coming weeks: the work of each item, the day it starts, the day it ends and who does it. A draft has no effect until it is published in a separate step.
gov11.lookAhead.form.open: Create the plan of a new week
gov11.lookAhead.form.created: The draft plan is saved. Review the items, then publish it with the Publish plan button.
gov11.lookAhead.form.noRight: You do not have the right to create the look-ahead plan of this project.
gov11.lookAhead.form.title: Create a draft look-ahead plan
gov11.lookAhead.form.maker: Creating the draft and publishing it are two separate steps: a draft does not count in the PPC and no constraint can be cleared or outcome recorded on it. Whoever publishes is recorded as the owner of the plan; let the person accountable for the works review the draft before it is published.
gov11.lookAhead.form.unverified: The window of {min} to {max} weeks comes from a default rule nobody confirmed; see the "i" next to it.
gov11.lookAhead.form.items: Items of work of the plan
gov11.lookAhead.form.paste: Paste several rows from a sheet
gov11.lookAhead.form.pasteHelp: One item a line: description, start day, end day (like 2026-11-10), who does it; columns apart by a tab, a semicolon or a vertical bar.
gov11.lookAhead.form.summary: {count} places are not right: fix the marked fields and send again.
gov11.lookAhead.form.error.weekInvalid: Pick a real day for the start of the week.
gov11.lookAhead.form.error.weekMonday: A week must start on a Monday so that the plans line up by week.
gov11.lookAhead.form.error.horizon: The number of weeks must be from {min} to {max} by the rule.
gov11.lookAhead.form.error.weekExists: The project already has a plan for the week starting {week}: open it from the list of weeks instead of making a second one.
gov11.lookAhead.form.error.itemsNone: A plan needs at least one item.
gov11.lookAhead.form.error.itemsMany: A plan holds at most {max} items.
gov11.lookAhead.form.error.descShort: The description of an item needs at least 3 characters.
gov11.lookAhead.form.error.descLong: The description of an item is at most 500 characters.
gov11.lookAhead.form.error.finishBefore: The end day cannot be before the start day.
gov11.lookAhead.form.error.startOutside: The start day must be inside the window of the plan.
gov11.lookAhead.form.error.responsibleLo: The name of who does the work is at most 200 characters.
gov11.lookAhead.form.refused.exists: The project already has a plan for this week. Reload the page to see it.
gov11.lookAhead.form.refused.window: The server refused the window of the plan: the rule may have changed. Reload the page and choose the weeks again.
gov11.lookAhead.form.refused.validation: The server refused what was entered. The fields keep their values so you can fix them.
gov11.lookAhead.form.refused.scope: You do not have the right to this project, or it is outside your scope.
gov11.lookAhead.history.open: Open the plan of this week
gov11.lookAhead.constraint.description: What has to be ready before the item starts
gov11.lookAhead.constraint.owner.error: The list of members could not be loaded; the constraint can still be recorded without an owner.
gov11.lookAhead.constraint.dueLate: The due day is after the day the item starts ({start}): the item will not be ready when the day comes.
gov11.lookAhead.constraint.error.kind: Choose a kind of the rule.
gov11.lookAhead.constraint.error.descSho: The description of a constraint needs at least 3 characters.
gov11.lookAhead.constraint.error.descLon: The description of a constraint is at most 500 characters.
gov11.lookAhead.constraint.error.due: Enter a real day for the due day.
